# sendio_api_key (Resource)

An API key. The token is returned once, when the key is created, and is kept (sensitive) in state; an imported key has no token. Destroying the resource revokes the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendio_domain" "mail" {
  name = "mail.example.com"
}

# A key that can only send from mail.example.com.
resource "sendio_api_key" "app" {
  name       = "app-production"
  permission = "sending_access"
  domain_id  = sendio_domain.mail.id
}

output "app_api_key" {
  value     = sendio_api_key.app.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Key name (at most 50 characters). Renaming updates the key in place.

### Optional

- `domain_id` (String) Restrict a `sending_access` key to one domain. Changing it creates a new key.
- `permission` (String) `full_access` (default) or `sending_access`. Changing it creates a new key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the key was created.
- `id` (String) API key id.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The secret key. Only known after create; null for imported keys.
- `token_prefix` (String) First characters of the token, as shown in the dashboard.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported keys have no token: it is only returned when a key is created.
terraform import sendio_api_key.app 9d2c3a41-7f1b-4c6e-8a2d-5e0f1b3c4d5e
```
